objective: Use RED/GREEN tests to implement a standard-library CLI that fail-closed validates TaskContract, route, receipt, dependency, and immutable-revision evidence with stable diagnostic codes.
deliverable: validate_evidence.py, focused tests, and a structured worker receipt.
read_scope: fixtures/adaptive-task-orchestrator-write-dag/tests/ and tools/ (read-only except declared new files)
write_scope: Unique automatically cleaned unittest TemporaryDirectory paths outside the project

authoritative_facts: Evidence JSON is untrusted boundary input and unknown shapes must fail closed.
Executable TaskContracts, preflight_fixture_record contracts, child RouteDecisions, root execution records, and WorkerReceipts are distinct shapes.
Current executable contracts must match an exact immutable revision copy.
accepted_upstream_results: The v0.3 spec and ADR-0006 are accepted.
user_constraints: Standard library only; no v0.1/v0.2 mutation, dependency install, network, or external runtime.
permissions: Edit only the two declared new validator files and use auto-cleaned OS temp directories.
non_goals: Do not validate OpenAPI semantics, reconstruct missing v0.2 contracts, or rewrite historical evidence.

acceptance_checks: Write malformed fixtures first and record targeted RED output before the tool exists or satisfies them.
Emit stable JSON findings for missing fields, invalid enums, unresolved dependencies, current/revision mismatch, illegal route state, and receipt revision mismatch.
Accept explicit preflight and root record variants without treating them as executable child contracts/routes.
Accept the completed v0.2 package under its declared historical boundaries.
Run the targeted test module with py -3 -B and report exact counts and exit codes.
